lines.2: 「But Murata holds a grudge like nobody else. He might not let that little incident go.」
lines.4: 「Yohei Murata. You don't know him? He's the brain of class 2-A, famous as the man raised in hell.」
lines.6: 「Yohei Murata has twelve little sisters, and apparently every one of them adores him.」
lines.10: What a spectacularly pointless backstory... Yohei Murata was terrifying.
lines.11: 「And that cute photographer is Noriko Nishizaki. She's like class 2-A's mascot, loves photography, and serves on the publicity committee.」
lines.12: 「You know an awful lot about them.」
lines.13: 「Murata and I were classmates last year, and Nishizaki's famous for being the cute type.」
lines.14: 「In other words, they're both celebrities in 2-A. You're just oblivious to that kind of thing.」
lines.16: Noriko Nishizaki, huh? She was cute, I supposed.
lines.17: But next to the Princess, she faded into the background.
lines.18: 「I failed to obtain the photograph in the end... How vexing.」
lines.20: 「So the boy who was with Fukahire is called Leo Tsushima. I have carved that name into my memory.」
